jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level role at Project/Regional Lead pay band, well above entry-level, and a litigation team manager post almost certainly requires legal qualification and years of experience the candidate lacks. Despite Reprieve's human-rights mission being a perfect interest match, the level and likely legal-qualification requirement are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is a genuine entry-level Coordinator role, so the level fits, but it is a fundraising/development function that sits outside the candidate's research and analysis strengths and their dedicated fundraising experience is limited. Reprieve's human-rights mission is appealing, but the fundraising specialism is a poor skills match, keeping the priority low.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% matched pension

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a Director role with ultimate executive responsibility, leading a senior team and requiring extensive leadership experience — far beyond entry-level and a hard level mismatch. The subject matter is interesting, but the seniority is a clear disqualifier.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it is a voluntary/advisory position seeking senior subject-matter authority the candidate does not yet have. Although human rights and criminalisation of defenders is a strong interest match, the level and nature of the posting are a hard mismatch.
jobs.type: Not specified (Advisory Committee — voluntary expert body)

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location policy is London only and this post is tied to Washington, DC with no London or remote-UK option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow level role above entry-level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate Policy & Development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role in development economics is not entry-level and typically requires substantial subject expertise (often a PhD or several years' experience) that the candidate lacks. Climate and development policy also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it functions as a volunteer/advisory appointment seeking specialists with a track record in the field, which the candidate does not yet have. The human-rights subject matter is on-mission, but the role type and seniority are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee — a senior advisory role requiring recognised expertise, not an entry-level paid position, and it reads as a voluntary/speculative committee appointment rather than a genuine paid vacancy for the candidate. The human-rights and securitisation subject matter is interesting, but the level and nature of the role are a hard mismatch.
